Source contracts: build/build.ps1

build/build.ps1

PowerShell · Tier B

Dispatch the Windows compiled builder with its original exit status.

Usage

Run build/build.ps1 with the Python driver arguments; use --help to inspect options.

Inputs

SMTO_BUILD_PYTHON, repository .venv/Scripts/python.exe or python from PATH, in that priority order.

Side effects

Runs tools/driver.py in UTF-8 mode; the driver owns compilation, signing checks and output writes.

Cleanup

The wrapper exits with the child status and does not delete driver artifacts.

@see build/tools/driver.py
